categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `scantxoutset` locking logic in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a race condition that leaves `scantxoutset` permanently blocked until node restart. As noted in the description and review discussion, overlapping calls or polling can trigger a state where all subsequent calls fail with 'Scan already in progress'.
